rules.title: H.3744 – Home rule petition authorizing Boston to implement rent stabilization
rules.requirement: Bill (home rule petition) that would authorize the city of Boston to implement rent stabilization. The page does not describe the content of the limits; the bill accompanied a study order on 9/9/2024.

coverage.notes: Would apply in the city of Boston; scope not described.

rules.coverage_text: City of Boston; the page gives no further coverage details.
rules.interaction: Special law of the MA legislature that would authorize Boston to act (Local Approval Received).
rules.quoted_span: By Representative Montaño of Boston, a petition (accompanied by bill, House, No. 3744) of Samantha Montaño (with the approval of the mayor and city council) that the city of Boston be authorized to implement rent stabilization and tenant eviction protections.

rules.title: H.3744 – Home rule petition authorizing Boston to implement tenant eviction protections
rules.requirement: Bill (home rule petition) that would authorize the city of Boston to implement tenant eviction protections. The page does not describe what the protections contain; the bill accompanied a study order on 9/9/2024.

coverage.notes: Would apply in the city of Boston; scope not described.

llm.notes: Bill status page. The last action listed is 9/9/2024, 'Accompanied a study order, see H5035'. In Massachusetts that generally ends the bill, so it was recorded as bill_failed. The page does not describe the bill's content, coverage, or dates. Jurisdiction is set to Boston (the petitioning city that would carry out the measures), but the special law itself would be passed by the MA legislature.
